etymologies.heading: Etymology
etymologies.text:
/sau/ → /sɔː/ → /soː/
Probably either a shift from 様(さま) (sama) or from 相(そう) (sō). Appears from the Muromachi period.
Possibly influenced by, or developed by analogy to, the adverbial and interjectional 然(そ)う (sō) above.
